BlasTech SE-14C Hold-Out Blaster.desc: +2 to conceal; single shot. Requires a full action to reload — most users fire once then switch to a sidearm. The SE-14C is the compact officer's sidearm of choice across the Imperial military and black market alike. Carry spare power packs if you rely on it.

BlasTech DH-17 Blaster Pistol.desc: Standard military sidearm used by Rebel soldiers and spacers across the galaxy. Reliable, widely available, and easy to maintain in the field. The workhorse blaster of the Galactic Civil War — if you see someone carrying one, they've seen action.

BlasTech DL-44 Heavy Blaster Pistol.desc: Heavy blaster pistol favored by smugglers and outlaws who need stopping power in a compact frame. Hits harder than any standard pistol at close to mid range. The compact power cell holds only 6 shots before a full-action reload — carry spare packs. Expensive, hard to find, and worth every credit.

BlasTech A-300 Blaster Rifle.desc: The A-300 is the standard-issue longarm for Rebel Pathfinders and Alliance ground troops. Good balance of power and accuracy in a durable, field-serviceable package. Used by militias, resistance fighters, and anyone who needs a dependable rifle and can't afford something heavier.

E-11 Blaster Rifle.desc: Imperial standard-issue blaster rifle. Compact, reliable, with folding stock and excellent range. Can fire two-round bursts. Flooding the black market as Imperial garrisons fall — a common sight in the hands of pirates, remnant soldiers, and opportunists across the Rim.

BlasTech A-180 Blaster.desc: Compact carbine favored by scouts, pilots, and boarding teams. Balances mobility and stopping power in a short, reliable package — the go-to longarm when space and weight matter.

BlasTech E-22 Blaster Rifle.desc: The double-barreled E-22 is the heavy assault rifle of Imperial shoretroopers and specialist units. Three-round burst capability and AP 2 make it devastating against armored targets. Heavier than a standard longarm; favored by anyone whose job involves punching through cover.

A280 Blaster Rifle.desc: Alliance favorite; powerful and accurate. A heavy, well-built rifle that hits harder than standard military issue. Requires Str d6 to handle without penalty. Favored by Rebel veterans and elite infantry — if you see someone carrying an A280, they know what they're doing.

BlasTech T-21 Light Repeating Blaster.desc: A heavy support weapon carried by Tusken Raiders, pirates, and anyone who needs sustained fire without a crew. The T-21 puts out a withering volume of fire at long range. Heavy and impossible to conceal — when you bring one out, everyone in the room understands what's about to happen.

E-Web Heavy Repeating Blaster.desc: Tripod-mounted Imperial heavy weapon — the E-Web turns any defensive position into a killing ground. Requires a two-person crew and an external power generator. A staple of Imperial garrisons and remnant forces across the Outer Rim. When one gets set up, the smart move is not to be in front of it.

Czerka Arms Vibroblade.desc: A vibrating blade that cuts through armor and flesh with equal efficiency. Czerka's standard vibroblade is the go-to for assassins, mercenaries, and anyone who needs to work quietly. Silent, reliable, and legal on most worlds — which is why so many people carry one.

Gamorrean Vibro-Ax.desc: Heavy vibro-weapon popularized by Gamorrean warriors — Jabba's palace guards made it infamous across the Outer Rim. Powerful strikes but harder to parry with. Common among Wookiees, Gamorreans, and other species who prefer a weapon with presence.

Vibro-Knife.desc: A compact vibro-edged blade — cheap, quiet, and always useful. Standard backup for soldiers when blasters fail or draw unwanted attention. Every spacer worth the name has one somewhere on their person.

MagnaGuard Electrostaff.desc: Electrified pole weapon designed for and used by General Grievous's MagnaGuard droids. One of the few weapons capable of blocking a lightsaber. Extended reach and armor-piercing shock emitters make it dangerous in trained hands — requires training to use effectively.

Shock Gloves.desc: Electrified combat gloves for close-quarters takedowns. Favored by enforcers and bounty hunters who need prisoners alive. Concealable enough to pass casual inspection.

Stun Baton.desc: Security-grade impact baton with a shock emitter. Standard issue for prison guards, riot control, and anyone whose job involves keeping people alive and cooperative.

Fragmentation Grenade.notes: AP 2, Medium Blast Template, one use
Fragmentation Grenade.desc: Standard fragmentation grenade. A thrown explosive with strong anti-personnel effect in a small area. Simple, reliable, and found in the kit of soldiers and mercenaries across every faction in the galaxy.

Thermal Detonator.notes: AP 4, Medium Blast Template, one use, restricted
Thermal Detonator.desc: High-yield military explosive charge. Compact, volatile, and heavily regulated — possession alone is enough to get you hauled in on most worlds. The preferred threat of bounty hunters, mercenaries, and people who need to make a very clear point.

Merr-Sonn Model 22T4 Scatter Blaster.desc: Short-range scatter weapon favored by pirates, cantina owners, and corridor defenders. No attack roll required — place the cone and every target inside makes an Agility roll or takes 2d6 damage. No effective range beyond the cone itself, but inside that cone, nothing walks away clean.

Padded Clothing.desc: Light padding beneath clothes. Minimal protection, easily concealed. Common for diplomats and those who need to look unarmed.

Leather/Jacket.desc: Thick leather or reinforced jacket. Slight protection with everyday appearance. Popular with pilots and smugglers.

Combat Armor (Light).desc: Light tactical armor. Good protection without limiting mobility. Standard for mercenaries and security personnel.

Stormtrooper Armor.desc: Imperial stormtrooper armor. White plastoid plate offers solid protection. Imposes a penalty to Agility-linked skills; highly recognizable and illegal for civilians.

Heavy Battle Armor.desc: Full military armor. Excellent protection but heavy and restrictive. Used by assault troops and heavy weapons specialists.

Comlink.desc: Personal communicator for voice contact. Short range; essential for coordination. Every spacer and soldier carries one.

Macrobinoculars.desc: High-magnification optical device. Extends vision dramatically. Essential for scouts, snipers, and anyone who needs to spot distant targets.

Glow Rod.desc: Portable light source. Illuminates dark corridors, caves, and ship interiors. Standard equipment for exploration.

Medpac.desc: Field medical kit with stimulants, bacta patches, and basic instruments. Grants +2 to Healing rolls; 5 uses before depleted.

Security Kit.desc: Slicing tools, code crackers, and bypass devices. +2 to Slicing or Repair when bypassing locks and security systems.

Tool Kit.desc: General mechanical tools for repairs. +1 to Repair rolls. Every mechanic and starship crew keeps one handy.

Stimpack.desc: Chemical stimulant patch. Removes one level of Fatigue when applied. Quick fix; overuse can be addictive.

Data Pad.desc: Portable computer for data access, maps, and basic slicing. Supports Research and Slicing skill rolls. Ubiquitous in the galaxy.

Breath Mask.desc: Filters breathable air in hostile environments. Essential for toxic worlds, space walks, or smoke-filled areas.

Energy Cell (Spare).desc: Replacement power pack for blaster weapons. Lightweight; experienced fighters always carry spares.

Binders.desc: Magnetic or mechanical restraints for prisoners. Standard for bounty hunters, law enforcement, and slavers.

Fusion Cutter.desc: High-temperature cutting tool. Cuts through hull plating, doors, and barriers. Essential for salvage and infiltration.

Grappling Spike Launcher.desc: Launches tethered spike for climbing or crossing gaps. Common among scouts and urban operatives.

Holorecorder.desc: Records and plays holographic messages and imagery. Used for intelligence, messages, and recording evidence.

Long-Range Comlink.desc: Upgraded comlink with boosted transmitter and directional antenna. Supports communication beyond local line of sight when relay networks are available.

Encrypted Comlink Module.desc: Add-on crypto unit for comlinks. Makes slicing or signal interception significantly harder for hostile listeners.

Bacta Patch.notes: Single use, instant d8 Healing on one treatment. No skill required.
Bacta Patch.desc: Sealed topical bacta strip for emergency field care. Stabilizes patients quickly and improves one immediate Healing attempt.

Antitoxin Injector.desc: Rapid auto-injector loaded with anti-venom compounds. Used by scouts and troopers operating in toxic or venomous environments.

Survival Kit (24h).desc: Compact emergency pack with rations, water purifier, thermal sheet, flare, and distress beacon. Designed to keep one person alive for a day.

Thermal Cloak.desc: Insulated cloak with heat-retaining fibers. Common for operations in polar regions, high-altitude worlds, and unheated ruins.

Slicer Spike.notes: Single use, +1 Slicing on one access attempt
Slicer Spike.desc: Disposable intrusion module used to bypass basic security systems. Favored by slicers and infiltration teams on tight schedules.

Detonator (Breaching Charge).desc: Shaped charge designed to open sealed doors or light barriers with focused force. Standard for boarding and hostage rescue operations.

Scanner Jammer.desc: Portable interference emitter that floods short-range scanners with static and false echoes. Best used for quick evasions or covert movement.

Climbing Gloves (Mag).desc: Magnetic grip gloves with micro-adhesion pads. Improve climbing on hulls, towers, and urban infrastructure.

Tracking Beacon.notes: Attach to target/item; detectable by tuned scanner
Tracking Beacon.desc: Thumb-sized transmitter beacon used to track moving targets, cargo, or vehicles. Popular with bounty hunters and intelligence operatives.
